reactNative.q: Why React Native instead of two native apps?
reactNative.a: One codebase means roughly half the build and maintenance work, while the app still feels native on both platforms.

mvp.q: How long does an MVP take?
mvp.a: Usually 6–10 weeks from kickoff to the store release, depending on scope. After a short discovery phase you get an exact timeline and a fixed price.

ownership.a: You do. Code, designs and accounts are yours from day one — no lock-in.

takeover.q: Can you take over an existing app?
takeover.a: Yes. We start with a short code audit, then fix what’s urgent and plan the rest.

founder.photoAlt: Petro Arva, founder of TEOS IT
founder.title: Hi, I'm Petro.
bio: I grew up in a village in Vojvodina, in the north of Serbia, and I still build software from here. I studied IT in Novi Sad, graduated in 2021, and have spent the five years since building mobile and web products across fintech, e-commerce, fitness and IoT.

I've led a React Native team for a German fintech app and a team of eight on a large e-commerce project, built a training and booking app for a Swiss fitness company, and worked with international teams at Vega IT and on IoT apps published to the App Store and Google Play. Along the way I mentored interns and junior developers and learned what makes projects go well: clear scope, honest estimates and shipping often.

I started TEOS IT to work that way with every client. Today I lead a small team with a dedicated UI/UX designer, and we also build our own apps — Kellion and Hortium — because shipping our own products keeps us sharp for yours.
